name: Poisoned Apple
source:
With no past to remember, you live peacefully with your companions in the forest. But as beasts and nightmares emerge, how long can it truly last?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你不再记得过去，和你的同伴在森林里平静地生活。但随着野兽和噩梦的出现，它真正能持续多久？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
